Name: OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop
Desc: An online shopping platform built with a microservices architecture, showcasing OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing across services.
Supported Operations: Calculate order totals and apply discounts

Helm Config._comment_version: Pinned to match the chart vendored in the aiopslab-applications submodule. Unpinned, `helm install` takes whatever is newest in the remote repo, which is not what this repo was written against: as of 2025-09 that is 0.41.0, which renamed loadGeneratorFloodHomepage to loadGeneratorTraffic/loadGeneratorVUs and so breaks the astronomy_shop_loadgenerator_flood_homepage-* problems outright. Results are also not reproducible across time without this.
